- README.md:86 | PROBLEM: The `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED` row describes the small-diff route as (`AUTOFIX_SKIP_DOC_ONLY`, `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_ADDITIONS`) but the route requires both `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_ADDITIONS <= n` AND `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_DELETIONS <= n`. The omission of `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_DELETIONS` is inconsistent with every other documentation site (CLAODE.md line 1889, agents.md line 94, changelog.d/4609-... line 6, and the PR description) which consistently name both bounds.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Change to (`AUTOFIX_SKIP_DOC_ONLY`, `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_ADDITIONS` / `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_DELETIONS`) to match the other docs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:802-806, 1479-1483 | PROBLEM: The jq predicate that matches a pending handoff comment is byte-identical at three call sites (the `claude_fixer_awaiting_session` guard at lines 802-806, the new `CLAUDE_HANDOFF_SKIP_SUPPRESSED` guard at lines 1479-1483, and the converged-verdict dedup at around line 777).
  WHY: A future format change to the handoff marker would need updating at all three sites. Suggested minimal fix: Extract the predicate into a shared shell function alongside `gate_fetch_marker_comments` so a marker-format change is a single-site edit.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
